title: Subdomain Takeover
summary: A DNS record points to a de-provisioned third-party resource that an attacker can claim, serving content on a trusted subdomain.
detection: Find CNAME/ALIAS records pointing to external services (S3, GitHub Pages, Heroku, Azure, etc.) that return provider 'not found' fingerprints. Confirm manually before claiming exploitability.
remediation: Remove dangling DNS records or reclaim the backing resource. Audit DNS when decommissioning services; monitor for provider fingerprints.
